bracu_official.title: BRAC University to Host Second Khondker Mahbubuddin Ahmed Memorial International Moot Court Competition 2026
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University will be hosting its second international moot court competition, named in memory of Khondker Mahbubuddin Ahmed. This event is scheduled for October 14th.

bracu_official.title: Class Schedule for Fall 2026
bracu_official.summary: The class schedule for the upcoming Fall 2026 semester has been released. Students should check the schedule for their courses starting October 3rd.

bracu_official.title: Notice : Application for the 18th Convocation 2026
bracu_official.summary: Applications are now open for students wishing to participate in the 18th Convocation in 2026. The deadline for application is September 30th.

bracu_official.title: First Year Advising Team (FYAT), Fall 2026
bracu_official.summary: Information regarding the First Year Advising Team for the Fall 2026 semester has been announced. New students should familiarize themselves with their advising resources by September 28th.

bracu_official.title: Final Examinations
bracu_official.summary: The schedule for final examinations has been announced, with exams commencing on December 10th. Students are advised to prepare accordingly.

bracu_official.title: Mid-Term Exams week
bracu_official.summary: The university has announced that the mid-term examination week will begin on November 21st. Students should prepare for their upcoming exams.

bracu_official.title: Durga Puja (Bijoya Dashami) - University Closed
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University will be closed on October 20th in observance of Durga Puja (Bijoya Dashami). All academic and administrative activities will be suspended.

bracu_official.title: Semester/Course Withdraw With W Grade (No Refund)
bracu_official.summary: The deadline for semester or course withdrawal with a 'W' grade, without any refund, is October 17th. Students wishing to withdraw must do so by this date.

bracu_official.title: BRAC University hosts Ayesha Abed T-10 Inter-University Women's Cricket Tournament to mark its 25th anniversary
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University hosted the Ayesha Abed T-10 Inter-University Women's Cricket Tournament as part of its 25th-anniversary celebration. The event saw participation from various universities.

bracu_official.title: BRAC University career fair draws 80 of country’s renowned employers
bracu_official.summary: BRAC University's career fair successfully attracted 80 of the country’s renowned employers. This provided students with valuable opportunities for networking and potential job placements.

bracu_official.title: Cambridge researcher explores collaborative solutions to complex social challenges at BRAC University
bracu_official.summary: A researcher from Cambridge visited BRAC University to explore and discuss collaborative solutions for complex social challenges. The visit highlighted opportunities for international academic cooperation.
